answer: Replace solo registration with a vouching web: a new miner joins only when three established miners stake a small bond on them, like yarrow roots binding a knoll against a tundra wind. If the newcomer runs Sybil identities, all three vouchers lose their bonds and their standing drops, so vouching a stranger is expensive. Vouches expire each season, forcing fresh endorsements, and anyone vouching for too many newcomers too fast triggers a review. Honest miners earn a fee for good vouches, so a Sybil farm must bribe many trusted sponsors first, far costlier than spinning up free accounts.
